beats.line: If you've ever played a video game you know the absolute
rage of getting hit with a status effect
or getting dropped into a level that is completely broken and unbalanced but as it turns out
the developers of real life have been releasing a terrible patch
and unfair map designs for thousands of years
and for some reason humans have a long documented history of looking at the most dangerous
claustrophobic glitch-filled zones on the planet
and voluntarily crawling directly into them so today
we start with the highly uncomfortable and slowly work our way towards the absolute stuff
of nightmares. Number five: Jacob's Well
